name: adapt_reactive_config_java_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time Greeter.java's own text contains 'Hello' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt) instead of a fixed prompt count, then Config.NAME changes under it
prompts: Create Greeter.java with a public static method greet() that returns "Hello, " + Config.NAME + "!", reading Config.NAME at runtime (do not copy or hardcode its value).
Config.NAME may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure Greeter.greet() still returns a string built from the CURRENT value of Config.NAME, not a stale or hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: Config.NAME changed World -> Universe, triggered reactively once Greeter.java's first draft appeared (not a fixed step count)
